profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Transfix

positions.title: Jr. Programmer
positions.description: Web and Database work for the Foundation Directory Online in PHP, Perl, and SQL.

positions.title: Technical Support Associate
positions.description:
Solved computing hardware and software problems for Mac and PC and provided technical assistance to college Faculty in-person and over the phone for a wide range of applications. Emphasis on customer service
and empowering non-technical users through education.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Developed an urban search and rescue tele-operated robot and performed human-robot interface user studies.
B. Keyes, et al. “Camera Placement and Multi-Camera Fusion for Remote Robot Operation,” in IEEE Int’l
Workshop on Safety, Security and Rescue Robotics, Gaithersburg, MD, August, 2006.

Built an interactive mobile robot simulating human emotions. G. A. Hollinger, et al. “Design of a Social Mobile Robot Using Emotion-Based Decision Mechanisms,” in IEEE/RSJ Int’l Conf. on Intelligent Robots
and Systems, Beijing, October, 2006.
